title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: State Theatre, Easton | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the State Theatre in Easton, Pennsylvania, USA, on 30 July 2003.

It was the sixth show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr returned to the State Theatre on 11 July 2006, 2 July 2010, 26 June 2012, and 9 September 2022.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
